ranks: Jumpstart 2022 (J22, 2022-12-02) and The Brothers' War Commander (BRC, 2022-11-18): the rest of each set

blocked.name: Pirated Copy
blocked.why: "Another creature with the same name" has no filter, and copyOnEnter's addSubtypes can't add Pirate only when it copies a creature (the ruling).

blocked.name: Kenessos, Priest of Thassa
blocked.why: "If you would scry a number of cards, scry that many plus one instead": no scry replacement event exists (they stop at would-mill and would-draw).

blocked.name: Brazen Cannonade
blocked.why: Its raid impulse lasts "until end of combat on your next turn"; impulse-exile has no such duration.

blocked.name: Mizzix, Replica Rider
blocked.why: The copy of a permanent spell gains haste and "sacrifice it at your end step"; copy-spell can't grant abilities to the copy.

blocked.name: Auntie Blyte, Bad Influence
blocked.why: "Remove X +1/+1 counters" as a cost: removeCounter.count is fixed.

blocked.name: Agrus Kos, Eternal Soldier
blocked.why: becomes-target can't narrow to "an ability that targets only it", and copy-ability has no copy-for-each-other-creature-it-could-target fan-out.

blocked.name: Angelic Cub
blocked.why: firstTimeEachTurn counts per targeting player (valiant); the Cub's "for the first time each turn" is by anyone.

blocked.name: Synchronized Eviction
blocked.why: The cost reduction needs "two creatures that share a creature type".

blocked.name: Hold for Questioning
blocked.why: "Its activated abilities can't be activated" for the enchanted permanent: prohibits.abilitiesOf takes a filter, not the attached permanent.

blocked.name: Mild-Mannered Librarian
blocked.why: "Becomes a Werewolf" replaces its creature types without setting P/T; animate forces base P/T and add-types only adds.

blocked.name: Magnanimous Magistrate
blocked.why: "You may remove that many reprieve counters. If you do" compares the counters it holds with the dead card's mana value; no cost or condition says that.

blocked.name: Ogre Battlecaster
blocked.why: cast-now has no "by paying {R}{R} in addition to its other costs", and nothing reads the cast spell's mana value back for the +X/+0.

blocked.name: Goblin Researcher
blocked.why: "During any turn you attacked with this creature": an impulse permission's gate reads the exiled card, not the Researcher.

blocked.name: Coalborn Entity
blocked.why: "Target creature token, player, or planeswalker": no target spec mixes players with a filtered set of permanents.

blocked.name: Hexavus
blocked.why: "Remove a counter from another creature you control" as a cost — a chosen creature, any kind of counter.

blocked.name: Rootpath Purifier
blocked.why: Makes lands you control basic, and land cards in your library basic.

blocked.name: Sanwell, Avenger Ace
blocked.why: Exiles the top six, may cast a Vehicle or artifact creature from among them, the rest to the bottom: cast-now's libraryTop looks rather than exiles.

blocked.name: Farid, Enterprising Salvager
blocked.why: Its modal activated ability's goad mode needs a target of its own.

blocked.name: The Brothers' War
blocked.why: Chapter II: each creature two chosen players control attacks the other chosen player each combat if able.

blocked.name: Ashnod the Uncaring
blocked.why: "If one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it" reads the triggering ability's cost; the sacrificed condition sees only the resolving ability's own.

blocked.name: Smelting Vat
blocked.why: Up to two noncreature artifact cards with total mana value at most the sacrificed artifact's.

blocked.name: Tawnos, Solemn Survivor
blocked.why: A token copy of the card exiled as a cost (an artifact in addition); exileFromGraveyard also can't sit beside the sacrifice-two cost.

blocked.name: Wreck Hunter
blocked.why: Counts nonland cards in a graveyard put there from the battlefield this turn; only the from-library version exists.

blocked.name: Kayla's Music Box
blocked.why: "{T}: Until end of turn, you may play cards you own exiled with Kayla's Music Box" — a granted play permission over the cards it exiled.

blocked.name: Glint Raker
blocked.why: +X/+0 where X is the greatest mana value among artifacts you control: greatestManaValueOf exists only as a layer-7a characteristic-defining ability.

blocked.name: Wire Surgeons
blocked.why: grantsToGraveyard covers flashback, escape, mayhem and dredge, not encore.

blocked.name: Disciple of Caelus Nin
blocked.why: Each player keeps up to five permanents and the rest phase out; then "permanents can't phase in".
